issues.on_page: Contributions in aid of construction 317,829 (inside Total nonoperating revenues (expenses) (1,208,015))
issues.issue: The proprietary statement prints this inside nonoperating revenues, and the Statement of Activities (p3) counts it as business-type Capital Grants and Contributions. Recording it as other_financing moves a printed revenue out of receipts, which conflicts with the 'as printed' rule. Consider making it a business-type receipt line. The roll-forward holds either way.

Grants kept in the last-resort other (detail category Grants). 2,185,090 of it is ARPA (federal, recorded as federal grants in detail[102]), and the Statement of Activities splits grants into operating and capital grants and contributions. A grants category may fit better than other. The same applies to the Grants detail lines.

The user rule labels every capital outlay line 'Capital Outlay: <function>', but this line and detail[107] (Wireless E911 27,279), detail[111] (Landline E911 83,709), detail[131] (Keno Betterment 161,777) and detail[136] (Capital Projects 1,190,704) keep the bare label. The E911 funds point to Public Safety.
